resources.string: Learn about our rules and safety.
Simply mention @jarvis in any comment section. Our AI agent will analyze the post and provide an intelligent response or summary.
Unlike regular search, AI-enhanced search understands context. It doesn\'t just look for keywords but finds the most relevant campus events, discussions, and news for you.
How do I get a verification badge?
Go to your society page and click \'Apply for Official Badge\'. University admins will review your credentials.
How to join a university society?
Browse societies in the \'Discover\' tab. Once you find one you like, hit \'Join\'. Some societies might require admin approval.
How do I report inappropriate content?
Click the three dots (⋮) on the top right of any post and select \'Report\'. Our moderation team reviews all reports within 24 hours.
Yes, when creating a post, toggle the \'Anonymous\' switch. Your identity will be hidden from everyone except system admins (for safety purposes).
Flame Cred is our reputation system. You earn it by posting helpful content, getting upvotes, and contributing to society discussions. Higher cred unlocks exclusive badges!
Can I customize my profile theme?
Currently, the app follows the Industrial Tech theme. We are working on allowing users to customize their profile accents in future updates.
If you encounter any issues with the UniFiltered app, please reach out to us.
